meta.name: linkedin-employee-advocacy
meta.description: Stand up and run a LinkedIn employee advocacy program for a marketing or sales team. Covers 14-day launch playbook, brand-guideline governance, per-post time budget, cadence benchmarks, and team ROI (reach, engagement, pipeline). Triggers on "employee advocacy", "get the team posting", "scale LinkedIn across team", "advocacy ROI". Not for planning one person's own calendar (use linkedin-content-planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把团队成员的个人发帖组织成有节奏、可衡量的品牌传播计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果市场或销售团队想在领英上统一发声并衡量效果
copy.tagline_en: Turn teammates' personal posts into a steady, measurable brand broadcast program
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a marketing or sales team wants consistent posting and measurable reach on LinkedIn

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你为营销或销售团队搭建并运营 LinkedIn 员工倡导项目:产出 14 天启动计划、运营模型、每位成员的发布节奏目标、KPI 看板规格和品牌安全治理手册。
howto.when: 当你提到 “employee advocacy”、“advocacy ROI” 等关键词,或想让整个团队在 LinkedIn 发帖、启动倡导项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 14 天启动计划开始团队员工倡导项目
我们团队发帖节奏不一致,帮我定每人的发布目标
say.note: 输出按人校准的发布频率

say.text: 给我一套衡量团队 LinkedIn 倡导 ROI 的 KPI 看板
say.note: 覆盖触达、互动与 pipeline 归因

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds and runs a LinkedIn employee advocacy program for a marketing or sales team: a 14-day launch plan, operating model, per-member cadence targets, KPI dashboard spec and governance playbook.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "employee advocacy" or "advocacy ROI", or want your whole team posting on LinkedIn and to launch an advocacy program.

say_en.text: Start our team employee advocacy program with the 14-day plan
Our team posts inconsistently - set realistic cadence targets per member
Give me a KPI dashboard spec for team LinkedIn advocacy ROI
